title: hold Fn to cycle the Touch Bar strips

clauses.text: holding Fn on the Apple keyboard cycles the Touch Bar strips, and a short press changes nothing

steps.do: Hold the Fn key on the Apple keyboard for about two seconds, then release it. Then press Fn quickly.
steps.expect: The strips change once after the first half second of holding, then again about once a second while held. A quick press changes nothing.

steps.do: If holding Fn does nothing, tap the on-screen chip that cycles the strips.
steps.expect: The chip still cycles the strips. Report that the Fn key does not reach the shell, if it does not.
